title: Messages
description: Things waiting for the person from Slack, Gmail, Outlook and other services mine syncs: mentions, direct messages and emails, newest first with unread ones emphasised. The person can mark one read. Documents in "messages": { sender?: string, subject?: string, preview?: string, at?: ISO datetime, unread?: boolean, channel?: string, url?: string, service?: string }. Mark one read with patch("messages", id, { unread: false }).
